Class NativeBlocks

java.lang.Object
com.happyuky7.openvoxelmoding.loader.NativeBlocks
public final class NativeBlocks extends Object
Native blocks: real engine block types added by mods, like Fabric/Forge block registration.

The game keeps its blocks in the BlockType enum. When that enum initializes, ModLoader appends one constant per registered block (see Transformer#extendBlockType). Each constant is an instance of a subclass generated here (BlockType$ML) whose properties (solid, light, opacity, render layer, gravity) come from the mod's definition, so the engine treats it exactly like its own blocks: meshing, lighting, collision, mining, saving, networking and inventory icons.

Blocks must be registered before the game loads its blocks, i.e. in ClientMod.onLoad(ModContext). The numeric type id is derived from the namespaced id, so a client and a server with the same mods agree on it without any sync. The dedicated server needs the same mod jar and the ModLoader agent.
